properties.formattedContent:
Question: verse for healing sickness

Answer: Several verses in the Bible speak to the power of healing and offer comfort during sickness. Psalm 103:2-3, for example, declares that God forgives all sins and heals all diseases. James 5:14-16 encourages calling for elders to pray and anoint with oil for healing. Additionally, Isaiah 53:5 reminds believers that "by his wounds we are healed," referring to Jesus' sacrifice.
Here are some other verses that can be a source of comfort and strength during times of illness::
- Psalm 6:2: "Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am faint; heal me, Lord, for my bones are in agony".
- Psalm 41:3: "The Lord will sustain him on his sickbed; in his illness you restore him to full health".
- Jeremiah 17:14: "Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise".
- Matthew 10:8: "Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those who have leprosy, drive out demons. Freely you have received, freely give".
- Isaiah 41:10: "So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand".
